title: 第九章 盐帮覆灭第十章 金错刀
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 李水生先刮下一点雪莲子粉末，放进嘴里，混合着水服下。
腹内一阵火热，内气开始快速恢复起来。
“老任是个实在人啊！”
“不愧是能做到一帮之主的人！”
“不仅能够快速恢复内气，整颗服下还能增长功力！”
“这效果，可比药浴强太多了！”
“怪不得人家天山是第一大派呢。”
“这可是好东西，得省着点吃。”
万一日后被追杀，他可以靠着天山雪莲子恢复内气，能施展轻功更久，自然跑得更远。
其他人，便是想追也追不上。
只要跑得够快够持久，死亡就追不上我！
这一段时间，镇子上总是飘着浓郁的血腥味，大多数商户都已经关门了，就兵器铺子还开着。
李水生封了医馆的铺门，等着杀鲸帮的高层翻墙进来。
半个月过去。
盐帮副帮主谢全擦去肩膀上的鲜血，“杀鲸帮这群贼子，到底发了什么疯，怎么一副不死不休的模样？”
就在这时，盐帮弟子过来禀报，“副帮主，李恒那贼厮，又杀过来了！”
谢全怒道：“不可能，他前些日子才被我所伤，怎么敢接着出来？”
谢全登上山寨了望台，看向远处，那个在人群中大杀四方的，不是受伤的李恒，还能是何人？
谢全双眼冒火，“抬我刀来！”
“我来战他！”
刚刚交手一合，谢全就察觉到了不对。
这些时日，他连战不休，一身实力只剩下八成。
可李恒中了自己一刀，应该也不好过，实力也只剩下八成左右才对啊。
可刚刚交手，他分明感受到对方实力仍然保持在巅峰状态。
交手不过二十合，谢全便一个抽身撤退，扔下了众多盐帮弟子，“不对劲，撤！”
同样的情况，在盐帮各地不断上演。
整个盐帮都弥漫着一股悲切的气氛。
又是半个月过去，谢全伤上加伤，再看对面的李恒，依旧龙威虎猛。
手持一根长棍，踏波而行，在一艘艘船上跳跃飞起，打杀盐帮弟子！
“副帮主，怎么办？”
谢全冷笑一声，“怎么办，还能怎么办？”
“帮主呢？”
“坐镇山寨呢。”
content_en:
Li Shuisheng first scraped off some snow lotus seed powder, put it into his mouth, mixed it with water and drank it.
There was a burning sensation in the abdomen, and the internal energy began to recover quickly.
"Lao Ren is a real person!"
"As expected of a man who can be the leader of a gang!"
"Not only can you quickly restore your inner energy, but taking the whole pill can also increase your power!"
"This effect is much better than medicinal bath!"
"No wonder Tianshan is the largest sect."
"This is good food, so you have to save some of it."
In case he is hunted down in the future, he can rely on Tianshan Snow Lotus Seeds to restore his inner energy. He can perform Qing Gong for a longer period of time and naturally run further.
Others cannot catch up even if they want to.
As long as I run fast enough and long enough, death can't catch up with me!
During this period of time, there was always a strong smell of blood in the town. Most of the businesses had closed, except for the weapons shop, which was still open.
Li Shuisheng sealed the door of the medical clinic and waited for the senior officials of the Killing Whale Gang to climb over the wall and come in.
Half a month passed.
Xie Quan, the deputy leader of the Salt Gang, wiped the blood from his shoulder, "What on earth have these thieves from the Killing Whale Gang got so crazy about? Why do they look so stubborn?"
At this moment, a disciple of the Salt Gang came over to report, "Deputy gang leader, that thief Li Heng is here to kill him again!"
Xie Quan said angrily: "Impossible. He was injured by me just a few days ago. How dare he come out again?"
Xie Quan climbed up to the lookout of the mountain village and looked into the distance. The person who was killing everyone in the crowd was not the injured Li Heng. Who else could it be?
Xie Quan's eyes were on fire, "Bring my sword!"
"I'll fight him!"
As soon as they met, Xie Quan noticed something was wrong.
These days, he has been fighting non-stop, and his strength is only 80%.
But Li Heng was stabbed by himself, so he shouldn't have a hard time, and his strength is only about 80%.
But just after the fight, he clearly felt that the opponent's strength was still at its peak.
After only twenty rounds of fighting, Xie Quan pulled away and retreated, leaving behind many Salt Gang disciples. "Something's wrong, retreat!"
The same situation is happening all over the Salt Gang.
There was an atmosphere of sadness throughout the Salt Gang.
Another half month passed, and Xie Quan was getting more injured. Looking at Li Heng opposite, he was still as powerful as a tiger.
Holding a long stick, he walked on the waves, jumped on a ship, and killed the Salt Gang disciples!
"Deputy gang leader, what should I do?"
Xie Quan sneered, "What should I do? What else can I do?"
"Where's the gang leader?"
"Staying in the village."
